join.heading: From plan selection to completion
join.subtitle: Structured Car Plan for your future car. Follow these steps in the company system.

0.title: Select a plan
0.text: Choose a car value tier that matches your goal and budget.

1.title: Review full info
1.text: Read plan details, contribution terms, installment examples and conditions carefully.

2.title: Apply
2.text: Submit your application with required personal and plan information.

3.title: Pay
3.text: Make the required contribution / payment through the approved company process.

4.title: Track
4.text: Follow payments, remaining amount, status and draw information on your dashboard.

5.title: Complete
5.text: Finish the plan path according to company terms toward your future car goal.

dashboard.heading: Track your Car Plan in one place
dashboard.subtitle: Members can monitor progress through the company digital system.

0.title: Payments
0.text: See contribution history and payment records.

1.title: Remaining
1.text: Know what is left toward your plan goal.

2.title: Status
2.text: Check application and plan status at any time.

3.title: Draw info
3.text: View lucky draw related information where a scheme applies.

draw.heading: Lucky draw where offered
draw.text: Some Car Plan paths may include optional lucky draw schemes. These operate only with applicable law and required approvals. Participation and outcomes follow company terms and regulatory conditions.

bank.heading: Company account → car → installments
bank.subtitle: Where bank partnership applies, the flow supports eligibility, verification and vehicle purchase with installment structure.

0.title: Company account
0.text: Open / maintain your account in the Yes Time Global system.

1.title: Eligibility
1.text: Company reviews eligibility for the selected Car Plan path.

2.title: Bank verify
2.text: Partner bank verifies required information under its process.

3.title: Buy car
3.text: Proceed to purchase the vehicle through the approved arrangement.

4.title: Installments
4.text: Continue structured monthly installments as per the plan example tiers.

disclaimer.title: Important Clarification
disclaimer.text: Example car values and monthly installments are illustrative (e.g. 30 Lakh → 36,000; up to 2.10 Cr → 252,000). Actual terms, eligibility, bank partnership and any lucky draw scheme depend on company policy, law and approvals. Car Plan is the installment booklet program separate from Car Saving marketplace.
